audience: OpenAI Codex is for people who already pay for ChatGPT, or who should, and want the coding agent included. The verdict says Codex is included with ChatGPT, and Plus at $20 is enough for a few focused coding sessions a week. Web, CLI, IDE, and iOS are the surfaces the pros list for Plus.

It is a poor fit if you wanted a published message cap. The cons say allowances are ranges, not a fixed message count. It is also a poor fit if you only have an API key and expected the cloud product. The API-key row is pay API rates, with no cloud features.
features: The plans match ChatGPT's ladder. Free is $0 a month. Go is $8 a month. Plus is $20 a month. Pro is $100, $200, or $500 a month. The API key is a separate door. You are not buying a second subscription called Codex on top of Plus.

Pro has no five-hour limit. That is the pro that separates it from Plus. Plus is the plan the verdict recommends for a few focused sessions a week. Pro is the plan when that window is the problem, and it starts at $100.
Fast mode is the other meter. It burns the included allowance at 2.5x. That is a multiplier, not a dollar surcharge we calculated. Leave it off if you are trying to make Plus last.
limitations: The pricing page gives local-message estimates per five hours for Plus, and it calls them estimates, not caps. GPT-6 Astra is 5 to 45. GPT-6.1 Sol is 15 to 160. GPT-6 Sol is 15 to 150. GPT-6 Luna is 350 to 3,000. Cloud tasks cost more of the same allowance, and weekly limits may also apply. Do not budget a sprint against the top of a range.
Business and Enterprise share Codex, and this page does not list a Business dollar price. We will not borrow one. A team that needs a seat price in writing does not have it here.

The rating is Worth it for Plus at $20 as a few sessions a week. Worth it does not mean the ranges are a guarantee, and it does not mean Go at $8 is the coding plan. Go is on the ladder. The verdict names Plus.
pricingNotes: From developers.openai.com/codex/pricing, checked 14 October 2026. Free is $0 a month. Go is $8 a month. Plus is $20 a month. Pro is $100, $200, or $500 a month. An API key is pay API rates and has no cloud features.

Plus local-message figures are estimates per five hours, not fixed caps: GPT-6 Astra 5 to 45, GPT-6.1 Sol 15 to 160, GPT-6 Sol 15 to 150, GPT-6 Luna 350 to 3,000. Fast mode burns the allowance at 2.5x. No Business dollar price is listed.

faqs.q: Do I need a separate Codex subscription?
faqs.a: No. Codex is included with ChatGPT. Plus at $20 a month is the plan the verdict calls enough for a few focused coding sessions a week. Go is $8. Pro starts at $100.

faqs.q: Are the message numbers a cap?
faqs.a: No. They are local-message estimates per five hours for Plus. The ranges are wide, cloud tasks cost more of the same allowance, and weekly limits may also apply.

faqs.q: What does an API key get me?
faqs.a: API rates, and no cloud features. If you wanted the web, CLI, IDE, and iOS product, that is the Plus plan, not the key.
A way to burn the included allowance at 2.5x. It is not a separate dollar fee in the table. Turn it off if you are stretching Plus.
